items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I've never had to hear the record of High Society with Roy playing the Picou's clarinet solo.

ctx.x: Okay, you were saying something about this record? Did Roy make it?
Yeah, Roy made a record, I understand, with Jelly Roll. I've never had to hear the record of High Society with Roy playing the Picou's clarinet solo. No, I don't think he did that. On the trombone.
No, I don't think he did that. No?
